conditions.warmup: immutable plans on joined temporary thread; small mutable workspace once on every measured worker
conditions.overlap: barrier start per phase; observed scheduling, not a forced worst-case peak

scope.allocator: System wrapped by process-global scalar atomics; no allocation in bookkeeping
scope.live_bytes: successful requested allocation sizes tracked continuously from process start; frees across window boundary included; realloc success changes net charge, failure retains old charge
scope.peak: maximum observed net live requested bytes during the window, including fixture/harness/retained state in the baseline
scope.request_bytes: alloc/alloc_zeroed sizes plus full realloc targets, including attempted requests
exclusions: native allocations bypassing the Rust global allocator
RSS and operating system resident memory
scope.first_small_hit: 224 additional bytes of request and retained delta in each first measured phase; scope includes synchronization/runtime metadata but exact attribution was not established; no subtraction
scope.quiescence: phase end barrier plus release barrier keeps input owners and TLS caches alive until sample capture
scope.counter_self_check: pre-window 64-byte allocation, zeroed allocation, grow/shrink realloc, free and retained negative delta; exact calls/request/peak/net checked

oracles.recovery: every shard compared byte-for-byte against encoded reference after each call; present state and missing destination pointer checked
oracles.retention: expected policy delta plus <=4096-byte synchronization allowance
oracles.request_budget: known workspace and temporary output payload through payload+4096 per worker
oracles.catalog: strict complete order of 3 thread counts x 3 repetitions x 7 phases for each policy

experiment_patch.scope: one private std cache-acquisition branch plus explicit alternative retention/request oracles in the external probe; no runtime flag added
experiment_patch.replay: git apply --check passed; actual application to two files from source_commit matched both experimental source files byte-for-byte

experiment: archive source_commit into a separate directory
run the same release test from the separate directory with a separate target-dir
reproduction.negative_control: in the patched directory, run the same cargo test flags with --lib decode_workspace_retention_counts_all_buffers_and_drops_oversized_entries; expected exit 101

negative_control.name: existing drop-oversized cache retention unit test
negative_control.interpretation: expected failure of the existing cache policy contract; experiment is not a green release candidate

workspace_all_features.counting: last summary per top-level executable; exclude self-spawned child duplicate summaries

decision: retain existing drop-smaller-cache runtime policy; production thread mix, size alternation rate and process peak budget remain unspecified
